blockingIssues.description: The Intervention Evidence panel claims to trace the active zone/posture/threshold recommendation, but it always renders static payload decision evidence and never changes with scenario state.

The shrink payload exposes only a single static evidence record, so observe/detain/escalate posture states and zone-specific recommendations have no scenario-specific evidence rows to justify the active UI state.
